notes.title: Private Beta and New Content
notes.content:
[h1]Beta[/h1]
The Fallen Empires private beta is now active. Please message lightningmanmedia on Steam to receive your beta key. 

[h1]New Content[/h1]
There will be a new trailer coming soon demoing some in-game improvements. Steam leaderboards, weekly community events, and lots of new features coming before and after launch. Stay tuned!
